# trq-lol plugin for Claude Code

> Skills for building with the public lol.trq Java libraries.

## Skills

- [alts](skills/alts/SKILL.md): Minecraft accounts
- [helios](skills/helios/SKILL.md): Forge 1.8.9 rendering
- [lazarus](skills/lazarus/SKILL.md): Forge 1.8.9 on modern Java
- [orpheus](skills/orpheus/SKILL.md): media sessions and lyrics

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install and development
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): rules for changing the skills
- [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md), [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md), [SECURITY](SECURITY.md)
